Causes fréquentes : relais sur un point: Common causes: relay on a noisier high point (it hears less well), different powers or antennas, badly tuned antenna, damaged cable. A node “nobody hears” probably transmits too weakly or too low for its neighbours. Only nodes that report what they hear are judged: MQTT gateways and nodes with the Neighbor Info module on (with “Also send over LoRa” for a relay without MQTT).
Causes probables, de la plus fréquente à: Likely causes, from most to least common: powerful transmitters on the site (cellular, FM, DTT, professional networks) saturating the receiver → 868 MHz band-pass filter, antenna away from the others; “RX boosted gain” off; local noise (switching power supply, solar panel, charge controller, screen); damaged node front end. A faulty cable or antenna hurts transmission as much as reception: they don't create this gap.
